_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/statics/test_static_has_flag.py. t_flag_siege is Windcrag Siege's Mardu half on a one-mana enchantment: the 'as this enters, choose' trigger writes a flag on the source, and a double_triggers static for attack causes is gated on it. t_flag_anthem is the same flag switching a self buff, so the characteristics cache is asserted to see the word arrive. t_attack_lifegainer GAINS LIFE when it attacks, so 'an additional time' is counted as life rather than queue entries.

• Jeskai — This enchantment gets nothing.
